courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 車站旅客流量模擬
related.transfer: 可遷移「樓梯出口有效淨寬」與「垂直運輸往返節拍」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；車站旅客流量模擬的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Effective width at stair exits" and "Round-trip vertical-service cycle" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Station passenger-flow simulation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦轉乘樓層高差通道分流與等候整合；車站旅客流量模擬則以旅客守恆局部密度與離散事件模擬為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on transfer-level changes route splitting and waiting integration; Station passenger-flow simulation centres on passenger conservation local density and discrete-event simulation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「樓梯出口有效淨寬」與「尖峰到達累積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到車站旅客流量模擬，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非常態需求與出口」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Effective width at stair exits” and “Accumulation under peak arrivals”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Station passenger-flow simulation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Exceptional demand and exits", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 軌道運輸無障礙月台
related.transfer: 可遷移「樓梯出口有效淨寬」與「垂直運輸往返節拍」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；軌道運輸無障礙月台的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Effective width at stair exits" and "Round-trip vertical-service cycle" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Accessible platforms for rail transit must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦轉乘樓層高差通道分流與等候整合；軌道運輸無障礙月台則以月台車輛幾何介面與連續無障礙路徑為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on transfer-level changes route splitting and waiting integration; Accessible platforms for rail transit centres on platform–vehicle geometry and continuous accessible journeys, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「樓梯出口有效淨寬」與「月台與車體界限」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到軌道運輸無障礙月台，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「協助登乘時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Effective width at stair exits” and “Platform and vehicle bounds”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Accessible platforms for rail transit, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Assisted boarding time", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 轉乘車站垂直動線
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1991 年一九八五年緊急整備指南於該年重印。；2015 年地下車站旅客流研究報告於該年出版。；2025 年臺灣鐵道車站概念設計指引函頒。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對轉乘樓層高差通道分流與等候整合而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用跨樓層轉乘時間及電梯停用替代路徑連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1991: The rail-transit emergency guide originally published in nineteen eighty-five was reprinted. 2015: A study of underground-station passenger flow was published. 2025: Taiwan issued guidance for conceptual railway-station design. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For transfer-level changes route splitting and waiting integration, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through travel time between levels and alternative routes during lift outages. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
